title: Thai Greetings
description: Start a conversation with a friendly hello and a polite thank you.
objectives: Recognize and say a common Thai greeting and thank-you phrase.
Identify a simple yes and no response.

examples.thai: สวัสดีครับ
examples.translation: Hello (ครับ is a polite particle commonly used by men; usage varies by speaker and context).

examples.thai: ขอบคุณค่ะ
examples.translation: Thank you (ค่ะ is a polite particle commonly used by women in statements; usage varies by speaker and context).

quiz.question: What does ขอบคุณ mean?
quiz.explanation: ขอบคุณ (khopkhun) means thank you.

quiz.question: Which phrase means hello?
quiz.explanation: สวัสดี (sawatdi) is a common greeting.

title: Numbers and Prices
description: Recognize a few useful numbers and ask how much something costs.
objectives: Recognize the Thai words for one, two, and three.
Ask how much an item costs.

examples.thai: อันนี้เท่าไหร่ครับ
examples.translation: How much is this? (ครับ is a polite particle commonly used by men; usage varies by speaker and context).

examples.thai: สองอัน
examples.translation: Two items. (อัน is a general classifier used for objects without a more specific classifier.)

quiz.question: What does สอง mean?
quiz.explanation: สอง (song) means two.

quiz.question: How do you ask 'How much?'
quiz.explanation: เท่าไหร่ (thao rai) means how much.

title: Introducing Yourself
description: Share your name and ask someone else’s in a simple introduction.
objectives: Introduce yourself using a common Thai name pattern.
Ask another person what their name is.

vocabulary.meaning: I / me (often used by women; choice depends on speaker and context)

examples.thai: ผมชื่ออเล็กซ์ครับ
examples.translation: My name is Alex. (ผม is commonly used by men; ครับ is a polite particle commonly used by men.)

examples.thai: คุณชื่ออะไร
examples.translation: What is your name? (A polite particle may be added at the end.)

quiz.question: What does ชื่อ mean?
quiz.explanation: ชื่อ (chue) means name.

quiz.question: Which phrase asks 'What is your name?'
choices: คุณชื่ออะไร
อันนี้เท่าไหร่
quiz.explanation: คุณชื่ออะไร (khun chue arai) asks what your name is.

title: Ordering Food
description: Use a few simple phrases to order something delicious.
objectives: Recognize useful words for rice, water, and food taste.
Ask politely for a glass of water and describe food as delicious.

examples.thai: ขอน้ำหนึ่งแก้วครับ
examples.translation: May I have a glass of water, please? (ขอ makes a polite request; ครับ is commonly used by men.)

examples.thai: อร่อยมากค่ะ
examples.translation: It’s very delicious. (ค่ะ is commonly used by women in statements.)

quiz.question: What does ไม่เผ็ด mean?
quiz.explanation: ไม่เผ็ด (mai phet) means not spicy.

quiz.question: Which word means water?
quiz.explanation: น้ำ (nam) means water.

title: Shopping
description: Ask about an item and say whether you would like it.
objectives: Point out an item and say you would like it or do not want it.
Ask the price using a question form.

examples.thai: เอาอันนี้ครับ
examples.translation: I’ll take this one. (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

examples.thai: ราคาเท่าไหร่คะ
examples.translation: How much is it? (คะ is commonly used by women as a question-final polite particle.)

quiz.question: What does อันนี้ mean?
quiz.explanation: อันนี้ (an ni) means this one.

quiz.question: Which phrase means 'I don't want it'?
quiz.explanation: ไม่เอา (mai ao) means don't want it or won't take it.

title: Asking for Directions
description: Ask where a place is and check whether it is nearby.
objectives: Ask where a place is.
Understand a simple direction to go straight.

examples.thai: ห้องน้ำอยู่ที่ไหนครับ
examples.romanization: hong nam yu thi nai khrap
examples.translation: Where is the restroom? (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

examples.thai: ตรงไปครับ
examples.translation: Go straight. (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

quiz.question: What does ที่ไหน mean?
quiz.explanation: ที่ไหน (thi nai) means where.

quiz.question: How do you say 'go straight'?
quiz.explanation: ตรงไป (trong pai) means go straight.

title: Everyday Expressions
description: Learn friendly expressions for saying sorry and asking someone to wait.
objectives: Recognize common phrases for apologizing and reassuring someone.
Ask someone to wait briefly in a service or everyday interaction.

vocabulary.meaning: please wait a moment (polite / service style)
help! (often urgent; not a neutral polite request)

examples.thai: ขอโทษครับ
examples.translation: Excuse me / I’m sorry. (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

examples.thai: ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ
examples.translation: It’s okay / no problem. (ค่ะ is commonly used by women in statements.)

quiz.question: What can ไม่เป็นไร mean?
quiz.explanation: ไม่เป็นไร (mai pen rai) commonly means it's okay or no problem.

quiz.question: What does ขอโทษ mean?
quiz.explanation: ขอโทษ (kho thot) means sorry or excuse me.

title: Thai Politeness
description: Get familiar with polite particles and when speakers commonly use them.
objectives: Distinguish the common uses of ครับ, ค่ะ, and คะ.
Recognize how หน่อย can soften a request.
teachingNote: ครับ is commonly used by men after statements and questions. Among speakers who use the feminine-associated particles, ค่ะ commonly ends statements and คะ commonly ends questions. ค่ะ and คะ have different tones even though this plain romanization writes both as kha. Particle choices vary with the speaker and context; these are common patterns, not rules for every speaker.

vocabulary.meaning: polite particle commonly used by men; can mark statements or questions
polite particle commonly used by women in statements
polite particle commonly used by women in questions

examples.thai: ช่วยหน่อยครับ
examples.translation: Please help me. (หน่อย softens the request; ครับ is commonly used by men.)

examples.thai: ไปไหมคะ
examples.translation: Would you like to go? (คะ is commonly used by women at the end of questions.)

quiz.question: Which is commonly used as a polite question particle by women?
quiz.explanation: คะ is commonly used by women at the end of questions; the plain romanization kha does not show its tone.

quiz.question: Which polite particle is commonly used by men?
quiz.explanation: ครับ (khrap) is commonly used by men as a polite particle after statements and questions.

title: Making Friends
description: Use simple questions to ask where someone is from and what they like.
objectives: Ask where someone is from.
Recognize a common phrase used when meeting someone.

vocabulary.thai: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก

examples.thai: คุณมาจากประเทศอะไร
examples.translation: What country are you from?

examples.thai: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จักครับ
examples.translation: Nice to meet you. (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

quiz.question: What does ชอบ mean?
quiz.explanation: ชอบ (chop) means to like.

quiz.question: Which phrase means 'Nice to meet you'?
choices: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก
quiz.explanation: ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก (yindi thi dai ruchak) means nice to meet you.

title: Basic Conversations
description: Put common questions and answers together for a short exchange.
objectives: Ask how someone is and give a simple positive response.
Return the question with “And you?”

vocabulary.thai: แล้วคุณล่ะ

examples.thai: สบายดีไหมครับ
examples.translation: How are you? (ครับ is commonly used by men as a polite particle.)

examples.thai: สบายดีค่ะ แล้วคุณล่ะ
examples.romanization: sabai di kha laeo khun la
examples.translation: I’m well. And you? (ค่ะ is commonly used by women in statements.)

quiz.question: What does สบายดีไหม mean?
quiz.explanation: สบายดีไหม (sabai di mai) asks how someone is.

quiz.question: What does แล้วคุณล่ะ mean?
quiz.explanation: แล้วคุณล่ะ (laeo khun la) means and you?
